title: Tomb Raider
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Universes Beyond Secret Lair drops)

paragraphs.text: Secretversary 2023 is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from November 20 until December 26, 2023.
The Superdrop contains nine drops , including three in the Universes Beyond series.
Buyers received a The Locust God promotional card for every $200 spent in a single order. In the first week of purchase, all purchases received a 10% discount.
The drops can be bought separately or in one of the ten bundles.
Goodie Bag Loaded with Everything Bundle for $499.99 includes one copy of each drop in foil and one copy of each drop in non-foil.
Goodie Bag Loaded with Foils Bundle for $299.99 includes one copy of each drop in foil.
Goodie Bag Loaded with Non-Foils Bundle for $219.99 includes one copy of each drop in non-foil.
Welcome to Jurassic World Bundle for $109.99 includes one foil copy and one non-foil copy of both Secret Lair x Jurassic World: Life Breaks Free and Secret Lair x Jurassic World: Dr. Ian Malcolm .
Lara Croft's Adventuring Bundle includes Secret Lair x Tomb Raider , Tales of the Time Stoppers & Through the Wormhole ($109.99 for foil and $75.99 for non-foil).
Holiday Gift Bag Bundle includes Through the Wormhole , Gift Wrapped & Paradise Frost ($99.99 for foil and $69.99 for non-foil).
Jungle Bundle includes Secret Lair x Jurassic World: Life Breaks Free , Secret Lair x Jurassic World: Dr. Ian Malcolm & Showcase: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan ($89.99 for foil and $69.99 for non-foil).

As an extra, each drop comes with a surprise bonus card. Except for the cases listed below, potential bonus cards include an alternate art Relentless Rats or an extended art elf (such as Elvish Vanguard , Elvish Visionary , Sylvan Ranger , or Wellwisher ).
